text:
ana_fin: FYI NebulaDynamics reported duplicate June invoice and one copy missing the reserved_gpu_sku line. Customer says their total charge doubled. PDFs in ticket #5042.

rob_support: Oof. Can you drop invoice IDs? I'll warn them and escalate.

ana_fin: IDs: inv-2026-06-neb-3301 and inv-2026-06-neb-3301-dup. Dup shows $24,300; original shows $15,150.

clare_billing: Looking into gateway logs now. billing-bot shows two identical invoice generation events for batch_id=202606-330 that both returned success. Duplicate detection didn't flag because the content hash differs (one missing reserved_gpu line).

billing-bot: automated note: invoice_job batch=202606-330 attempts=2 status=success generated=[inv-2026-06-neb-3301, inv-2026-06-neb-3301] duplicate_check=result=missed write_hashes=[a1f3..., b7c9...]

vishal_engineer: Quick debug: retry path after transient DB timeout triggered a full regenerate. On the first run pricing lookup for reserved_gpu_sku failed due to a normalization bug: we expect sku lowercased without dots but sometimes value arrives as 'Reserved.GPU.A100' and lookup returns null. Code silently skips missing pricing entries. Also retry path doesn't set dedupe_token when retrying after a timeout.

sara_ops: So two separate failures: missing dedupe token on retry -> duplicate invoice; and sku normalization mismatch -> missing line on one invoice.

vishal_engineer: Correct. Repro: run invoice worker with env PRICING_NORMALIZE=false and you'll see the reserved line skipped. Fix plan: 1) enforce normalization at ingestion, 2) make invoice generation raise on missing pricing entries in dry-run mode, 3) ensure retry path preserves dedupe_token. Patch ID: BILLFIX-312.

clare_billing: Finance proposal: hold off voiding until eng runs a replay. If replay produces a single correct invoice, we'll void the duplicate and reissue the corrected invoice. If customer was charged twice, issue immediate refund/credit.

ana_fin: Agreed. I'll prepare a customer-facing statement and provisional credit if necessary. Rob, leave the customer note to say we're investigating and will follow-up with corrected invoice.

rob_support: Noted. Updating ticket #5042 with timeline and provisional credit language.

billing-bot: automated note: BILLFIX-312 deployed to staging at 2026-06-10T11:05Z.

vishal_engineer: Staging replay dry-run executed: dedupe now detected duplicate and normalization adds the reserved_gpu_sku line. Dry-run output shows a single invoice with total $15,150 matching expected. I'll schedule prod deploy + replay in 30m.

sara_ops: We'll monitor for webhook jitter and watch payments system for duplicate charges during replay.

clare_billing: After prod replay, finance will void inv-2026-06-neb-3301-dup and reissue corrected invoice. Also will create a credit memo if both payments went through.

ana_fin: Action items: 1) Deploy BILLFIX-312 to prod and run billing-replay --batch 202606-330 --dry-run (vishal), 2) Prod replay and monitor (sara), 3) Finance void/reissue/credit where needed (clare), 4) Postmortem + runbook update to fail loud on missing pricing keys and require dedupe token preservation (owner: clare).

rob_support: Thanks team. I'll notify customer when void/reissue done.

clare_billing: One more: add a CI check to run a sample invoice generation with intentionally malformed SKUs to ensure we don't silently drop lines. I'll open BILL-PR-431 for that.

vishal_engineer: PR opened. Scheduling prod deploy now.

billing-bot: automated note: replay scheduled: billing-replay --batch 202606-330 --dry-run --dedupe-key dedupe_token
